claims.value: Granite-Embedding-311M-Multilingual-R2 is a 311M parameter dense embedding model for high-quality multilingual text embeddings, producing 768-dimensional vectors. It supports 200+ languages with enhanced support for 52 languages and code.
claims.evidence: Granite-Embedding-311M-Multilingual-R2 is a 311M parameter dense embedding model from the Granite Embeddings collection for high-quality multilingual text embeddings. It produces 768-dimensional vectors
It produces 768-dimensional vectors with a context length of up to 32,768 tokens.
The model is designed to produce fixed-length vector representations for a given text
